name: endroit/work
description: Experimental resolution of Room-owned work from explicit intent to inspectable evidence and review.

capabilities.description: Resolve the current frontier, missing contracts and proof obligations of one Work Item.
Present and record a bounded human review without accepting or delivering the Work Item.

skills.description: Resolve one owned Work Item before execution or closure.

commands.description: Inspect ordered surfaces and record explicit human review outcomes.

commands.name: inspect
commands.description: Inspect one Work Item and its typed contract.

commands.name: resolve
commands.description: Calculate the deterministic Work Resolution Frontier.

commands.name: review
commands.description: List ordered human review targets and their local availability.

commands.name: record-review
commands.description: Atomically record one explicit review outcome.
